result:
Six test files show failures in the progress output. The run was cut off, so I can't confirm the full list.

**Failing test files I could confirm:**
- `tests/test_arguments.py`
- `tests/test_basic.py`
- `tests/test_commands.py`
- `tests/test_context.py`
- `tests/test_options.py`
- `tests/test_parser.py`
- `tests/test_utils/test_echo_via_pager.py` (its failure tracebacks are visible in the tail of the output)

**Caveats:**
- The tool truncated the middle of the output, so I can't see every progress line. There may be more failing files in the omitted section. The run needs to be rerun, or its output saved to a file, to get the complete list.
- The header says `collected 33653 items / 31000 deselected / 2653 selected`. The config is deselecting most of the suite, so this was not really the complete suite. Check `pyproject.toml` for the deselection setting if you want every test run.
- I didn't modify any files. The `test_echo_via_pager` failures look like they depend on the pager environment, but I haven't investigated that.
